scenario.name: No-fault baseline
scenario.description: Healthy steady state: all five normally-closed radial lines (G01-N02, N02-N03, N03-N04, N03-N05, N05-N06) stay closed and both tie lines (N02-N05, N04-N06) stay open. No controller commands are issued. Use this run to capture reference voltage/current traces for comparison against the fault scenarios.
